t.name: Eagle Lakes Trail
t.description: This short trail drops down from the Aurora Ridge Trail to access the uppermost of the Eagle Lakes.

t.name: Pyramid Mountain Trail
t.description: The trail ascends through forest to Pyramid Mountain offering views of Lake Crescent below.

t.name: Aurora Creek Primitive Trail
t.description: The Aurora Creek trail rises an astonishing 3700 feet in 3.4 miles, from the edge of Hwy 101 to its junction with the Aurora Ridge Trail.

t.name: Aurora Ridge Trail
t.description: A steep moderate to difficult climb which follows a forested ridge past Sourdough Peak and Aurora Peak.

t.name: North Fork Sol Duc River Trail
